source_title: Eight ‘Real Housewives’ To Make Off Broadway Debuts In Neil Simon’s ‘Rumors’ Revival
source_excerpt:

Eight of Bravo’s Real Housewives cast members will make their Off Broadway debuts in a reimagined revival of Neil Simon ’s 1988 comedy farce Rumors beginning this January, producers announced today.
The Rumors revival at the Newman Mills Theater at The Robert W. Wilson MCC Theater Space will star two batches, in succession, of Real Housewives cast members, with Lisa Rinna , Phaedra Parks, Stacey Rusch and Dolores Catania appearing from January 9, 2027, to February 28, 2027. From March 2 to April 21, the production will star Cynthia Bailey, Eileen Davidson, Carole Radziwill and Candiace Dillard-Bassett.

Seven of the Housewives will be making their New York stage debuts – Lisa Rinna has appeared on Broadway in Chicago and will appear this holiday season in the Broadway “radio play” of It’s a Wonderful Life. Watch on Deadline
Following the January 9 first preview, the 14-week engagement will officially open January 25.
Directing will be Zhailon Levingston, whose directed the buzzy Cats: The Jellicle Ball on Broadway last season.
Additional casting will be announced at a later date.
In a statement, director Levingston said, “I first experienced Rumors as a child, and I can still remember the overwhelming sound of laughter filling the theater. That feeling of collective joy and release has stayed with me ever since. To me, Neil Simon’s comedy is a masterclass in the architecture of laughter, and I’ve long been baffled that this extraordinary play hasn’t received a major revival in recent years.
“What excites me,” he continued, “about reimagining Rumors through the lens of The Real Housewives is how naturally these two worlds collide. Without changing a single word of Simon’s brilliant text, we can reveal something new in the piece: The delicious chaos that unfolds when private lives become public spectacle. At a time when we are so deeply divided, I can think of few things more necessary than gathering in a theater to laugh together. My hope is to introduce a new generation to the same exhilarating feeling I experienced as a child, while reminding longtime lovers of Neil Simon just how timeless, audacious, and wildly funny his work remains.”
The revival will be produced by Benson Drive Productions (George Strus, CEO).
Here’s the official synopsis: “Reality was just rehearsal. When four couples gather for a party in a wealthy New York suburb, they expect champagne, revelry, and a night of good fun. Instead, they find their host in an alarming state, his wife missing, and the police on their way. Talk about a dinner party from hell!”

निर्माताओं ने घोषणा की है कि ब्रावो के शो 'द रियल हाउसवाइव्स' की आठ सदस्य नील साइमन के 1988 के कॉमेडी नाटक 'र्यूमर्स' के नए पुनरुद्धार में अपना ऑफ-ब्रॉडवे डेब्यू करेंगी, जो इस जनवरी से शुरू होने वाला है।

उत्पादन घोषणा के अनुसार, 14 सप्ताह का यह कार्यक्रम द रॉबर्ट डब्ल्यू. विल्सन एमसीसी थिएटर स्पेस के न्यूमैन मिल्स थिएटर में आयोजित किया जाएगा। इस प्रस्तुति में हाउसवाइव्स के दो समूह क्रमिक रूप से नजर आएंगे:

* **पहला समूह (9 जनवरी – 28 फरवरी, 2027):** लीसा रिन्ना, फेड्रा पार्क्स, स्टेसी रश और डोलोरेस कैटानिया।
* **दूसरा समूह (2 मार्च – 21 अप्रैल, 2027):** सिंथिया बेली, ईलीन डेविडसन, कैरोल राडजिविल और कैंडियास डिलार्ड-बास्केट।

### उत्पादन अनुसूची और विवरण

* **पहला पूर्वावलोकन:** 9 जनवरी, 2027
* **आधिकारिक उद्घाटन रात्रि:** 25 जनवरी, 2027
* **निर्देशक:** झाइलॉन लेविंगस्टन (जिन्होंने पिछले सीजन में 'कैट्स: द जेलीकल बॉल' का निर्देशन किया था)
* **निर्माता:** बenson ड्राइव प्रोडक्शंस (जॉर्ज स्ट्रुस, सीईओ)

लीसा रिन्ना को छोड़कर—जिन्होंने पहले ब्रॉडवे में 'शिकागो' और 'इट्स ए वंडरफुल लाइफ' के मंचन में काम किया है—बाकी सात हाउसवाइव्स का यह न्यू यॉर्क मंच पर पहला डेब्यू होगा। भविष्य में अतिरिक्त कलाकारों की घोषणा किए जाने की संभावना है।
* 
### निर्देशक का दृष्टिकोण और सारांश

निर्देशक झाइलॉन लेविंगस्टन ने एक बयान में कहा कि इस पुनरुद्धार का उद्देश्य नील साइमन के मूल पाठ को बदले बिना यह दिखाना है कि जब निजी जीवन सार्वजनिक तमाशा बन जाता है तो किस तरह की अराजकता फैलती है।

**आधिकारिक सारांश:** जब एक अमीर न्यू यॉर्क उपनगर में चार जोड़े पार्टी के लिए एकत्रित होते हैं और शैंपेन तथा उत्सव की उम्मीद करते हैं, तो इसके बजाय वे अपने मेजबान को एक चिंताजनक स्थिति में पाते हैं, उनकी पत्नी गायब होती है और पुलिस आ रही होती है।

### व्यावहारिक निहितार्थ और सत्यापन

नाटक में शामिल होने के इच्छुक दर्शक एमसीसी थिएटर या आधिकारिक प्रोडक्शन चैनलों के माध्यम से टिकट उपलब्धता, आधिकारिक कार्यक्रम और भविष्य के अपडेट की पुष्टि कर सकते हैं।

en_body:
Producers have announced that eight cast members from Bravo's 'The Real Housewives' will make their Off-Broadway debuts in a reimagined revival of Neil Simon’s 1988 comedy farce 'Rumors', scheduled to begin performances this January.

According to the production announcement, the 14-week engagement will take place at the Newman Mills Theater at The Robert W. Wilson MCC Theater Space. The run will feature two rotating groups of Housewives performing in succession:

* **First Cast (January 9 – February 28, 2027):** Lisa Rinna, Phaedra Parks, Stacey Rusch, and Dolores Catania.
* **Second Cast (March 2 – April 21, 2027):** Cynthia Bailey, Eileen Davidson, Carole Radziwill, and Candiace Dillard-Bassett.

### Production Schedule and Details

* **First Preview:** January 9, 2027
* **Opening Night:** January 25, 2027
* **Director:** Zhailon Levingston (known for last season's 'Cats: The Jellicle Ball')
* **Producer:** Benson Drive Productions (George Strus, CEO)

With the exception of Lisa Rinna—who has previously appeared on Broadway in 'Chicago' and a holiday stage production of 'It’s a Wonderful Life'—the production marks the New York stage debuts for seven of the participating Housewives. Additional casting announcements are expected at a later date.

### Director's Vision and Synopsis

Director Zhailon Levingston noted in a statement that the revival aims to explore the chaos that ensues when private lives become public spectacles, without altering Neil Simon's original text.

**Official Synopsis:** When four couples gather for a party in a wealthy New York suburb expecting champagne and celebration, they instead discover their host in an alarming state, his wife missing, and law enforcement approaching.

### Practical Implications and Verification

Audiences interested in attending can verify ticket availability, official schedules, and future casting updates directly through the MCC Theater or official production channels. Prospective attendees should rely strictly on authorized ticketing platforms to confirm performance dates.
